items.text: Freeze the cross-language query and result inventory

children.text: Literals: HeatmapMode=wall_time|tokens|models; HeatmapQueryKind=matrix|cell_evidence; HeatmapValueState=measured|derived|partial|unavailable; HeatmapScaleAvailability=available|unavailable; available scale basis=visible_row_maximum|context_window_capacity; resolutions=1|5|15|30|60.

Matrix request: snapshot_id, query_kind=matrix, from_time, to_time, mode, requested_resolution_minutes, maximum_rows. Rust maps exact camelCase Tauri fields to snake_case worker fields; TypeScript uses an equivalent readonly discriminated type.
Cell-evidence request: snapshot_id, query_kind=cell_evidence, mode, row_id, period_start_time, period_end_time. The evidence cap is protocol-fixed at 100 and cannot be expanded by a caller.

Matrix result: immutable read-lease snapshot_id and revision_id, query_kind=matrix, mode, from_time, to_time, requested_resolution_minutes, actual_resolution_minutes, maximum_rows, omitted_row_count, mode-specific row_order, total_cell_count, rows, bounded provenance. The service derives both identifiers from the acquired read lease, never mutable pending-handle state.

Matrix row: row_id, row_kind=runtime_state|token_measure|model|cost, friendly label, a discriminated scale, and ordered cells. Scale is exactly available with numeric minimum, numeric maximum, and basis=visible_row_maximum|context_window_capacity, or unavailable with availability=unavailable and a bounded N/A reason; nullable-field cross-products are invalid.

Matrix cell: start_time, end_time, nullable numeric value, formatted_value, value_state, applicable_zero, contributing_evidence_count, nullable normalized intensity, nullable supporting_text. Unknown capacity has null intensity and no percentage.

Cell-evidence result: immutable read-lease snapshot_id and revision_id, query_kind=cell_evidence, mode, row_id, friendly row_label, period_start_time, period_end_time, raw nullable numeric value, formatted_value, value_state, applicable_zero, evidence_items, omitted_evidence_count, bounded provenance. The service never reads identity from mutable pending-handle state.

Evidence item: nullable deterministic event_id, occurred_at, raw nullable numeric value, formatted_value, nullable duration_ms, friendly label, bounded sanitized preview, evidence_method, value_state, and has_detail. Items are chronological, at most 100, and path/transcript/secret/ciphertext safe.

Python dataclasses are service authority; report_worker serializes exact snake_case; Rust validates and projects exact camelCase; contracts.ts rejects unknown/missing fields, invalid discriminants, non-finite numbers, bounds, correlation mismatches, and path-shaped content.

FastMCP exposes only the additive discriminated schema through mcp_server.py and mcp_report.py. Schema snapshots prove retained query_time_range is unchanged and dynamic queries do not invoke static generation or export.

Python owner controls application_service.py, mcp_report.py, report_worker.py, mcp_server.py, test_application_service.py, test_mcp_report.py, test_report_worker.py, and test_mcp_server.py only. Start with failing contract and compatibility tests.

Replace generic event-cache grouping with one shared pure classic-semantic aggregation and formatting helper over read-lease-bound _ReadHandle.run. Matrix and cell_evidence paths both consume it. Traverse agents/responses in stable source order, merge intervals, calculate token rows, normalize model/effort, and preserve price/evidence status through streaming bounded processing without eager preview or detail materialization.

Use parsed inference/runtime/activity evidence only while the run-bound read lease and immutable revision remain coherent. Distinguish applicable zero from missing evidence. If the run cannot preserve a required distinction, stop and return the concrete gap to Dev Architect; do not coerce absence to zero or add a cache migration.

Change only the snapshot worker binding and service method to query_snapshot_time_range. Validate exact matrix/cell_evidence combinations and serialize the exact result union; preserve all other bindings.

Update mcp_report.py and mcp_server.py solely for the additive public signature, request construction, result projection, and focused tests. Retained query_time_range implementation and schema remain untouched.

items.text: Prove every functional facet and accepted decision

children.text: HM-F01: service and Workspace tests expose exactly three modes and reject atomic token measures dynamically; retained MCP atomic measures still pass.
HM-F02: Python tests cover present known states in fixed order, absent-state omission, ascending unknown states with friendly labels, unavailable timing, complete zero, and range overlap.
HM-F03: Python and contract tests assert the exact eight Tokens rows and order.

HM-F04: tests cover response model/effort, uniform non-mixed thread fallbacks, mixed non-fallback, Unknown model, no-effort label, distinct efforts, first occurrence across stable agent order, and Cost last.
HM-F05: tests cover half-open clipping, touching/nested/multi-agent overlap, union without double count, partial usable intervals, unavailable timing, and complete zero.
HM-F06: tests cover completion buckets; token sums; completed tool counts; positive context average/max; recorded/API-equivalent cost subtotal; processed-token model sums; missing contributors.

HM-F07: Python and TypeScript tests cover duration, compact number, integer tool count, context token/known-capacity percentage, classic cost precision, partial prefix, zero, and unavailable formatting.
HM-F08: tests cover stable agent traversal, main/default roles, nickname/assignment fallback and duplicate suppression, model-effort labels, headings, cells, evidence headings, and accessible names.
HM-F09 plus JFP-HM-01: tests distinguish measured/derived zero from partial/unavailable for every row family; no missing timing, usage, price, or capacity becomes zero. UX review evaluates wording.

HM-F10 plus JFP-HM-02: tests cover the true scale discriminator, valid available numeric variants, rejection of mixed/nullable cross-products, known capacity, unavailable N/A scale, null cell intensity, no percentage/fallback, optional token supporting text, disclosure, and accessible N/A descriptions.

HM-F11: matrix has no evidence ledger or full details; cell_evidence streams at most 100 chronological rows and exact omission without eager preview/detail materialization; full detail remains a separate existing lazy event-detail action within the same query_snapshot_time_range design boundary.

HM-F12 plus JFP-HM-03: Workspace tests cover select, double-click/Drill down, context-menu/Step back, breadcrumb, Previous/Next, horizontal controls, five periods, keyboard, reset, and disabled boundaries.

HM-F13: tests cover time, value, optional duration, bounded sanitized preview, token agent/model prefixes, friendly runtime/tool/model labels, availability, privacy, chronology, and optional detail identity.
HM-F14: tests cover 2,000 acceptance, 2,001 rejection, nearest supported coarser resolution, actual resolution, deterministic row omission/count, and HLD-accepted extreme-range behavior.
HM-F15: Workspace tests and browser verification cover row, local period, mode, formatted value, availability, scale basis, selection, focus, and synchronized evidence without color dependence.

Independent UX review inspects all modes, zero/partial/unavailable/N/A, selected evidence, disabled navigation, keyboard focus, narrow layout, and reduced motion; findings return to the TypeScript owner.
